views.markdown: Show Wi-Fi RSSI (Received Signal Strength Indicator) in the status bar in place of the Wi-Fi bars. The number is in dBm: -50 is stronger than -70. iOS 16 and later.

Requires iOS 16 or later. Tested on iPhone 8 Plus (non-notched) with iOS 16.6 and Dopamine RootHide and on iPhone 11 Pro Max (notched) with iOS 26.0.1 and Dopamine 3 RootHide.

Rootless and native RootHide. Native RootHide installs directly without Patcher.

- RSSI now follows the system status bar color, including black text in light apps.
- Fixed the RSSI and battery indicators shifting after closing Control Center on iOS 26.
- Improved VPN badge spacing in both iOS 16 bars and in iOS 26 Control Center.
- iOS 16 Control Center uses a fixed 14-point regular font for RSSI, even when the carrier name is absent.

- Fixed an iOS 26 Control Center freeze when toggling Airplane Mode. `Searching` and `No Service` display normally again.
- Kept the signed RSSI reading clear of the VPN badge with a fixed width.
- Matched the carrier font when visible and used 16-point regular when the carrier label is absent.
